comment: S92 R7: gradients of 5 to 16 stops on rounded boxes, drawn as gradient primitives through the renderer's stop table (no mask layer): a 16-stop rainbow, a 7-stop radial gradient in a bordered elliptical box, a transparent middle stop, 11 stops, hard stops of an ellipse in a 50 % box. Tolerance: the curves' edge pixels, which the engine covers analytically from the rounded rectangle's distance over a one-pixel ramp and Skia by the covered area: scattered single pixels and short runs differ by up to about 40 levels (no shape difference; the gradients' colours match). Measured 0.362 % on glcore and Vulkan (the mask layers of the mesh path before S92: 0.289 %); the limit is that plus about 10 %, the cluster limit stays at the default (16 px).
